page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs mapped directly to 48 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, each vCPU has dedicated physical execution resources, eliminating hyperthreading contention and providing highly predictable compute performance.

The instance is configured with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local NVMe storage or GPU accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high memory capacity offer a robust resource profile for enterprise workloads that require predictable CPU performance and large memory footprints. This server is designed for workloads such as in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing applications.
